description: This Python script provides a command-line interface (CLI) for interacting with the LiteLLM proxy server. It includes functions to display a styled prompt, show available commands, set up the interactive shell, handle special commands, execute user commands, and run the interactive loop with user input. The script leverages the 'click' library for CLI styling and command management.

methods.name: styled_prompt()
methods.description: Creates and displays a styled blue prompt box for user input and retrieves the input.

methods.name: show_commands()
methods.description: Displays a list of available CLI commands and their descriptions.

methods.name: setup_shell(ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Initializes the shell by showing a banner, server connection info, and available commands.

methods.name: bool handle_special_commands(user_input: str)
methods.description: Processes commands like 'exit', 'help', and 'clear' to perform special actions.

methods.name: execute_command(user_input: str, ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Parses and executes a user-input command by invoking the corresponding click command.

methods.name: interactive_shell(ctx: click.Context)
methods.description: Main loop that runs the interactive prompt, handling user input until exit.
